verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, no tabernáculo do testemunho, no primeiro dia do mês segundo, no segundo ano de sua saída da terra do Egito, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai, in the Tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt,

verses.en: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
verses.pt: Tomai o censo de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, com a conta dos nomes, todos os homens por suas cabeças:
verses.en_web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one;
verses.en_bbe: Take the full number of the children of Israel, by their families, and by their fathers' houses, every male by name;

verses.en: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.pt: De vinte anos acima, todos os que podem sair à guerra em Israel, os contareis tu e Arão por suas tropas.
verses.en_web: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.
verses.en_bbe: All those of twenty years old and over, who are able to go to war in Israel, are to be numbered by you and Aaron.

verses.en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.pt: E estará convosco um homem de cada tribo, cada um chefe da casa de seus pais.
verses.en_web: With you there shall be a man of every tribe; everyone head of his fathers’ house.
verses.en_bbe: And to give you help, take one man from every tribe, the head of his father's house.

verses.en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.pt: E estes são os nomes dos homens que estarão convosco: Da tribo de Rúben, Elizur filho de Sedeur.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of those who are to be your helpers: from Reuben, Elizur, the son of Shedeur;

verses.en: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.pt: De Simeão, Selumiel filho de Zurisadai.
verses.en_web: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.en_bbe: From Simeon, Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai;

verses.en: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.pt: De Judá, Naassom filho de Aminadabe.
verses.en_web: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.en_bbe: From Judah, Nahshon, the son of Amminadab;

verses.en: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.pt: De Issacar, Natanael filho de Zuar.
verses.en_web: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.en_bbe: From Issachar, Nethanel, the son of Zuar;

verses.en: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.pt: De Zebulom, Eliabe filho de Helom.
verses.en_web: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.en_bbe: From Zebulun, Eliab, the son of Helon;

verses.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.pt: Dos filhos de José: de Efraim, Elisama filho de Amiúde; de Manassés, Gamaliel filho de Pedazur.
verses.en_web: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.en_bbe: Of the children of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama, the son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur,

verses.en: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.pt: De Benjamim, Abidã filho de Gideoni.
verses.en_web: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.en_bbe: From Benjamin, Abidan, the son of Gideoni;

verses.en: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.pt: De Dã, Aiezer filho de Amisadai.
verses.en_web: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.en_bbe: From Dan, Ahiezer, the son of Ammi-shaddai;

verses.en: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.pt: De Aser, Pagiel filho de Ocrã.
verses.en_web: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.en_bbe: From Asher, Pagiel, the son of Ochran;

verses.en: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.pt: De Gade, Eliasafe filho de Deuel.
verses.en_web: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.en_bbe: From Gad, Eliasaph, the son of Reuel;

verses.en: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.pt: De Naftali, Aira filho de Enã.
verses.en_web: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
verses.en_bbe: From Naphtali, Ahira, the son of Enan.

verses.en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.pt: Estes foram os nomeados da congregação, príncipes das tribos de seus pais, capitães dos milhares de Israel.
verses.en_web: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: These are the men named out of all the people, chiefs of their fathers' houses, heads of the tribes of Israel.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
verses.pt: Tomou pois Moisés e Arão a estes homens que foram declarados por seus nomes:
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses and Aaron took these men, marked out by name;

verses.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.pt: E juntaram toda a congregação no primeiro dia do mês segundo, e foram reunidos suas linhagens, pelas casas de seus pais, segundo a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, por suas cabeças,
verses.en_web: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.
verses.en_bbe: And they got together all the people on the first day of the second month; and everyone made clear his family and his father's house, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and over.

verses.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.pt: Como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés; e contou-os no deserto de Sinai.
verses.en_web: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.en_bbe: As the Lord had given orders to Moses, so they were numbered by him in the waste place of Sinai.

verses.en: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: E os filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes por suas cabeças, todos os homens de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Rúben, foram quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Forty-six thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Reuben were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Simeão, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, os contados deles conforme a conta dos nomes por suas cabeças, todos os homens de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Simeon were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Simeão, cinquenta e nove mil e trezentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Fifty-nine thousand, three hundred of the tribe of Simeon were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Gade, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Gad were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Gade, quarenta e cinco mil seiscentos e cinquenta.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.en_bbe: Forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty of the tribe of Gad were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Judá, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Judah were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Judá, setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Seventy-four thousand, six hundred of the tribe of Judah were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Issacar, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Issachar were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Issacar, cinquenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Fifty-four thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Issachar were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Zebulom, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta de seus nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Zebulun were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Zebulom, cinquenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Fifty-seven thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Zebulun were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de José: dos filhos de Efraim, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Joseph were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Efraim, quarenta mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Forty thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Ephraim were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Manassés, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Manasseh were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Manassés, trinta e dois mil e duzentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Thirty-two thousand, two hundred of the tribe of Manasseh were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Benjamim, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Benjamin were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Benjamim, trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Thirty-five thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Benjamin were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Dã, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Dan were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Dã, sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Sixty-two thousand, seven hundred of the tribe of Dan were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Aser, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra.
verses.en_web: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Asher were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Aser, quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Forty-one thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Asher were numbered.

verses.en: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Naftali, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;
verses.en_web: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
verses.en_bbe: The generations of the sons of Naphtali were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Os contados deles, da tribo de Naftali, cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Fifty-three thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Naphtali were numbered.

verses.en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.pt: Estes foram os contados, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, com os príncipes de Israel, que eram doze, um por cada casa de seus pais.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers’ house.
verses.en_bbe: These are they who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and by the twelve chiefs of Israel, one from every tribe.

verses.en: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.pt: E foram todos os contados dos filhos de Israel pelas casas de seus pais, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra em Israel;
verses.en_web: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel;
verses.en_bbe: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel, by their families, all those of twenty years old and over who were able to go to war,

verses.en: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: Foram todos os contados seiscentos três mil quinhentos e cinquenta.
verses.en_web: even all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.en_bbe: Were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.

verses.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.pt: Porém os levitas não foram contados entre eles segundo a tribo de seus pais.
verses.en_web: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.
verses.en_bbe: But the Levites, of the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered among them.

verses.en: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Porque falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.pt: Somente não contarás a tribo de Levi, nem tomarás a conta deles entre os filhos de Israel:
verses.en_web: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
verses.en_bbe: Only the tribe of Levi is not to be numbered among the children of Israel,

verses.en: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.pt: Mas tu porás aos levitas no tabernáculo do testemunho, e sobre todos os seus utensílios, e sobre todas as coisas que lhe pertencem: eles levarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios, e eles servirão nele, e assentarão suas tendas ao redor do tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle, and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
verses.en_bbe: But to them you are to give the care of the Tent of meeting with its vessels and everything in it: they are to take up the Tent, and be responsible for everything to do with it, and put up their tents round it.

verses.en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.pt: E quando o tabernáculo partir, os levitas o desarmarão; e quando o tabernáculo parar, os levitas o armarão: e o estranho que se chegar, morrerá.
verses.en_web: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And when the Tent of meeting goes forward, the Levites are to take it down; and when it is to be put up, they are to do it: any strange person who comes near it is to be put to death.

verses.en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Israel assentarão suas tendas cada um em seu esquadrão, e cada um junto à sua bandeira, por suas tropas;
verses.en_web: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.
verses.en_bbe: The children of Israel are to put up their tents, every man in his tent-circle round his flag.

verses.en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.pt: Mas os levitas assentarão as suas ao redor do tabernáculo do testemunho, e não haverá ira sobre a congregação dos filhos de Israel: e os levitas terão a guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho.
verses.en_web: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
verses.en_bbe: But the tents of the Levites are to be round the Tent of meeting, so that wrath may not come on the children of Israel: the Tent of meeting is to be in the care of the Levites.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.pt: E fizeram os filhos de Israel conforme todas as coisas que mandou o SENHOR a Moisés; assim o fizeram.
verses.en_web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.
verses.en_bbe: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
